1722-2034-3583-5332.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-5332.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

1420-2178-2438.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-2438.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

1957-4050-4063--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When you sacrifice that creature, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

6495-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
6495-7096--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
6495-7096--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-969-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-969-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-6351-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5226-7913--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-7913--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Iron Lad.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

104-2685-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2685-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3099-3755-7060.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

997-1619-4605-5542-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6138.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6138.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more counters on it

186-243-4050-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Heartstone and removing two counters from it, returning Plague Belcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Plague Belcher enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Plague Belcher, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

433-3257-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
433-3257-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-4681-5231.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-5259-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-5259-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Rude Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1661-3835-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

647-1563-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

650-710-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

1170-2921-5006--23.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-2921-5006--23.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5696-6167.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6167.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Ior Ruin Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Ior Ruin Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

277-3129-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
277-3129-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-3129-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Tiller Engine triggers, untapping both Everywhere tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-1603-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Evil Twin is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-1603-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1379-2580-4246.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Lethal Vapors triggers, destroying that creature.
Because Null Rod prevents Lethal Vapors's activated ability from being activated, it cannot be destroyed due to its ability.

2034-4010-4231-5270.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-4010-4231-5270.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Farmer Cotton trigger, creating two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Farmer Cotton, adding {C}{C}.
If Farmer Cotton is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing the three Foods, returning Farmer Cotton to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite colored mana, which can be used to cast Farmer Cotton for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to create infinite Food tokens.

1636-3652-4913-5220.notablePrerequisites: Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3652-4913-5220.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability, causing you to draw Ornithopter from your library, then allowing you to put a land onto the battlefield from your hand, and repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control eight or more lands, this combo will continue until you have an empty library, and otherwise it can be done infinitely.

2-198-1651-4814.notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
"Mirran" chosen with Mirrodin Besieged.
2-198-1651-4814.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Myr and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

893-2089-4067-4659.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Symmetry Matrix.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

1642-4843.notablePrerequisites:
Virtus does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Virtus.
Warlock Class is level three.
1642-4843.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Virtus.
Virtus triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3407-4285.manaNeeded: {R}{R}{R}, plus an additional {R} if Dual Strike was not foretold, plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3407-4285.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional instant and/or sorcery card in hand.
3407-4285.description:
Cast any other instant and/or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dual Strike by paying {R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value 4 or less.
Cast Increasing Vengeance by paying {R}{R}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell cast in step 1.
Dual Strike triggers, copying Increasing Vengeance, with the copy targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the copy of Increasing Vengeance, copying Increasing Vengeance, with the copy targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat step 5.

937-2358-4551.description:
During your upkeep, activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and one life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
